requirements.title: Outgoing transfers
requirements.intent: A customer can send money from their own account to a valid IBAN.

acceptance.text: Only the account owner can create a transfer.
Transfers above balance plus overdraft are rejected.
Invalid IBANs are rejected before any money moves.

non_functional: Money is integer cents end to end.

requirements.title: Transfer fees
requirements.intent: Fees are predictable and shown before sending.

acceptance.text: SEPA transfers are free.
Instant transfers cost 0.2 %, minimum EUR 0.50.
Instant transfer fee is capped at EUR 5.00.
Fees round half-up to the cent.
acceptance.note: No acceptance test supplied by the product owner.

requirements.title: Daily transfer limit
requirements.intent: Limit fraud losses per account per day.

acceptance.text: Daily limit is EUR 10,000 for basic and EUR 25,000 for premium accounts.
Pending transfers count toward the daily limit.
A transfer that lands exactly on the limit is allowed.

requirements.title: Idempotent retries
requirements.intent: A client retrying after a timeout never pays twice.

acceptance.text: Retrying with the same idempotency key returns the original transfer and debits once.
Idempotency keys are scoped to the user who sent them.
acceptance.note: No acceptance test supplied by the product owner.

requirements.title: Multi-currency display
requirements.intent: Show SEK accounts for Swedish customers.

acceptance.text: SEK amounts display as '1 234,56 kr'.
Parsing a two-decimal amount is exact.

requirements.title: Account data access
requirements.intent: Nobody can read or move another customer's money or data.

acceptance.text: Every API handler that takes an account_id checks ownership.
Customers can list their own transfer history.
After 5 failed logins an account is locked for 15 minutes.
A successful login resets the counter.

requirements.title: Audit trail
requirements.intent: Every money movement and every failed attempt is auditable.

acceptance.text: Every created transfer writes an audit entry.
Rejected transfers write an audit entry with the reason.
Logs never contain a full IBAN.

requirements.title: Transfer metrics
requirements.intent: Operations can see transfer volume and failures.

acceptance.text: Created and rejected transfers increment counters.
Unused columns are removed without losing data that is still read.

requirements.title: Statement export
requirements.intent: Customers download a CSV statement including their memos.

acceptance.text: CSV includes day, recipient, amount, fee and memo.

requirements.title: Fee transparency
requirements.intent: The customer sees exactly what they will pay before sending.

acceptance.text: The fee updates when the amount or transfer type changes.
The total debited (amount + fee) is shown before sending.

requirements.title: Remember transfer type
requirements.intent: Frequent instant-transfer users do not re-pick the type every time.

acceptance.text: The last used transfer type is preselected on the next visit.
